## Investigation findings

**Bottom line:** One root cause. `ts-seat-service` has stalled outbound HTTP POST calls on its ticket-query path (`POST /api/v1/seatservice/seats/left_tickets` → `SeatController.getLeftTicketOfInterval`). The other degraded services are downstream victims of that stall. I found no evidence of a second independent fault.

### Affected endpoints and services

Compared with the normal baseline, these services show the abnormal latency and errors. Each has about 15 error spans in the window, and the incident is concentrated around 02:40–02:42 on 2025-07-20.

| Service | Normal avg / p95 | Abnormal avg / p95 | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|
